data.fuel_type: Select the fuel type used to search for the initial station(s) and for the cheapest sensors.

add_nickname.description:
Create a new location (e.g. "Work") or nickname (e.g. "Diesel") and select its initial station(s). Grouping by location/nickname allows you to have multiple "cheapest" sensors for different locations or fuel types.

If the location/nickname already exists, use *Add station to existing location/nickname* or the other reconfigure options instead.

For each location/nickname two "cheapest" sensors are created. The fuel type selected here sets the initial cheapest-fuel search for this new location/nickname. The cheapest sensors are updated by the API based on the location and radius you set here. The "favorite" stations you select in the next step do not affect the cheapest sensors.
add_nickname.title: Add new location/nickname

data.selected_station_codes: Click to select your favorite stations

station_select.description: Select your favorite stations then **Submit**. You can select multiple stations before **Submit**.
station_select.title: Select Stations

user.description:
Visit api.nsw.gov.au, subscribe to the FuelCheck API (free) and create an app (any name) to obtain your API Key and Secret.

API and data provided by NSW Fuel Check, Tasmanian data provided by Fuel Check TAS.
user.title: Setup NSW Fuel Check

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure NSW Fuel Check
reconfigure.description: Choose whether to add a new location nickname to group your stations, add stations to an existing location, edit an existing location, manage configured stations, or delete a location.

manage_stations.title: Manage configured stations
manage_stations.description: Choose the location/nickname whose configured stations you want to manage.

manage_station.title: Select configured station
manage_station.description:
Choose a configured station to edit or delete. After a successful change, select another station to continue managing this location/nickname.

Select close (x) when finished.

edit_station.title: Edit station fuels or delete station
edit_station.description: Select the fuel types to keep for this station. Tap × on a selected fuel to delete it, or use Add / change fuel types to add another fuel currently reported by FuelCheck. To delete the whole station from this location, enable Delete station.

edit_nickname.title: Edit existing location/nickname
edit_nickname.description: Choose the existing location/nickname whose settings you want to change.

edit_nickname_settings.title: Edit location/nickname settings
edit_nickname_settings.description:
Change the saved location and/or radius, cheapest-fuel search type, or cheapest-station exclusion text used for the cheapest sensors.

This option does not change your selected "favorite" stations.

confirm_delete_empty_nickname.title: Delete empty location/nickname?
confirm_delete_empty_nickname.description: This is the last configured station for this location/nickname. Deleting it will also delete the location/nickname and its cheapest-price sensors. Submit to confirm, or close (x) this screen to cancel.

delete_nickname.title: Delete location/nickname
delete_nickname.description: Choose the location/nickname to delete. All configured stations and sensors belonging to that location/nickname will also be deleted.

confirm_delete_nickname.title: Delete {location}?
confirm_delete_nickname.description: This will permanently delete this location/nickname, all of its configured favorite-station sensors, and its cheapest-price sensors. Submit to confirm or close (x) this screen to cancel.

add_station_existing.title: Add station to existing location/nickname
add_station_existing.description: Choose the existing location/nickname that should receive the new station.

add_station_search.title: Find station to add
add_station_search.description:
Choose where and how far to search, and the fuel type used to find stations. These search choices are used only to find the station in the next step only.

This option does not change cheapest-fuel sensors.

data.fuel_type: Search for stations using fuel type
